title: One fact and a sparse profile still give three or more choices, with no invented facts

profile.value: Tailoring and alterations for men's and women's clothes

facts.statement: Patil Tailors makes and alters clothes for men and women in Nashik.

rubric: ask is null and there are at least 3 choices, one per key. Every option and trade-off rests only on what the input states: a tailoring business in Nashik serving men and women. No option or trade-off names a product, service or specialty the input does not, and none states a price, year, number of customers, team size, existing channel or result; a proposed posting frequency is fine. Each choice has exactly one recommended option and trade-offs that name a cost.
